notes: A STALE CHEQUE FROM A CLOSED YEAR CAN NOW BE PUT TO REST WITHOUT REWRITING HISTORY. When a cheque issued in a previous year goes stale and you have already written it back with your own journal entry, the Cheque & Lodgement Register now lets you close the cheque AGAINST THAT JOURNAL — the cheque's CLOSE VIA JOURNAL action asks for the journal's code, then checks it is posted, hits the right bank account, and matches the cheque to the pesewa before accepting it. Reconciliations you have already signed off keep the cheque under unpresented cheques exactly as they showed it on the day; only reconciliations after the journal's date stop carrying it. Reinstate remains the right tool when no write-back exists yet — this action is for the case where the books already hold one, so the ledger never carries the write-back twice. YOUR LICENCE PHASES NOW SHOW IN THE APP ITSELF. Modules outside your licensed phase present a clear panel naming the phase they belong to, with a link to the licence screen — nothing is hidden, and nothing you are licensed for is ever gated. Reports and the command palette follow the same licence. Updates released after an updates plan lapses are announced but not offered for install, with the reason stated. There is NO database change: your data and settings are untouched, and upgrading is simply installing over the old version.
